# EXC007: defer-ticket-missing

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | EXC |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | error |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A defer directive names a ticket that does not exist.

The ticket resolves to nothing in the ledger. Fix the id or file the ticket
that will pay the debt. Not evaluated without a ledger.

## Examples

### EXC007 defer pointing at a missing ticket / Fires on an unknown ticket #1 (line 6) (fire)

<!-- frob:waive DOC004 reason="generated example copied from the rule's test corpus" -->
```rust
/* frob:defer COV001 because="split after the parser lands" ticket=01J9QKX3M8Z4T7N2V5B6C0D1E2 */ // error: EXC007
pub fn f() {}
```
